Thanks Diego — appreciate the heads up. Quick answers from AP:

1) We prefer SEPA for EU invoices, but our treasury needs the invoice split by legal entity (Acme EU vs Acme Global) so routing and VAT reclaim are clean.
2) If you can send separate invoices (one for Acme EU with VAT ID, one for Acme Global net), that'll expedite payment.
3) Escrow isn't our standard — treasury will pay once invoices match onboarding records.

We also need a completed supplier onboarding form (we attached our internal form to AP). Once that and the split invoices are in, we expect payment within 3 business days.
